map.为什么实际续航常低于标称？: Why is real runtime often below the rated value?
map.便携设备按典型功耗估算单次充电使用时长。: Estimate portable device runtime per charge from typical power draw.
map.储能系统按负载曲线估算离网支撑时间。: Estimate off-grid support time from the load curve in an energy storage system.

map.影响。锂电池浅充放（如 20%–80%）循环寿命明显长于满放满充；储能系统常限: Lithium batteries shallow cycling (say 20%-80%) last clearly longer in cycle life than full discharge and full charge; storage systems often limit DoD to extend life.
map.放电深度影响寿命吗？: Does depth of discharge affect life?
map.标称多按轻载/理想条件，实际受屏幕亮度、温升、老化和放电截止影响；深度放电还会加: Rated values assume light load and ideal conditions, while real life is affected by screen brightness, temperature rise, aging and cutoff voltage; deep discharge also speeds up degradation.
map.电池续航计算器。输入电池容量（mAh/Wh）与设备工作电流或功率，估算可使用时长: Battery runtime calculator. Enter battery capacity (mAh/Wh) and the device draw current or power to estimate how long it lasts, helping with battery selection and runtime estimates for digital devices, IoT and portable products.
map.：电池 60 Wh、平均功耗 15 W、电源效率 0.9：可用≈60×0.9/1: : a 60 Wh battery at 15 W average draw and 0.9 power efficiency gives about 60 x 0.9/15 = 3.6 h available. Tip: doubling the load (gaming, rendering) halves runtime, and usable capacity also drops in cold conditions.
